name: precip_rain
_comment: T-I5a-DR-particle-motion-quality: DENSE camera-relative rain. The emitter GEOMETRY (origin/extent/fall/aspect/jitter/lifetime) is kept at the gate-blessed values from the original B2 emitter so the WeatherVisual/Precipitation wind-slant relationship (windy streaks lean measurably more than calm) is preserved -- ONLY the DENSITY (spawn_rate) and the streak COLOUR/ALPHA are reworked here. Combined with the alpha-blended translucent streak shader + the darkened storm dome, this reads as bright translucent rain falling past the viewer in motion (no sky speckle, no dark dashes).
